ideaTypes.label: Insight + Link
ideaTypes.description: Concise insight from the article with a link card. The link card displays nicely on Bluesky.

ideaTypes.label: Mini-Thread
ideaTypes.description: 2-3 posts unpacking one key point from the article. 300 characters max per post.

ideaTypes.label: Community Question
ideaTypes.description: Ask the Bluesky community for their take on the article's topic.

toneGuidelines: Bluesky audience skews tech-savvy and values substance over polish
Less performative than LinkedIn, less casual than Threads. Thoughtful middle ground
Starter packs and topic feeds matter for discovery
Link cards display nicely. Can include the blog link directly
structureRules: For threads: each post should make sense on its own
Include the article link in the post (it renders as a rich card)
No hashtags unless they map to a Bluesky feed
hookFormula: Sharp observation or genuine question. No performative hooks.
hashtagStrategy: Skip hashtags unless they map to a specific Bluesky feed.
